facilities.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/karick-lake-north-campground-blackwater-river-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120109 ('dump station, restrooms and showers, boat ramp and pier'; 'Water Drinking') + FDACS ('Restrooms and showers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Florida Forest Service campground on its own ReserveAmerica site (or 1-877-879-3859): 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance' (window shown Oct 21 2026 to Sep 21 2027). All sites are site-specific; a campground host is on site. Cancelling 1 or more days before arrival costs a $9 non-refundable fee.

The Florida Forest Service offers camping discounts for people 65 and older, active-duty military or honorably discharged veterans, and the 100% disabled 'at applicable camping facilities'; documentation is registered by calling (877) 879-3859.

discounts.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/karick-lake-north-campground-blackwater-river-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120109 ('The Florida Forest Service offers camping discounts for individuals age 65 and older, active-duty military or honorably discharged veterans, and for individuals 100% disabled at applicable camping facilities'), read 2026-10-21

note: Florida Forest Service campground on the north side of 65-acre Karick Lake. Boat ramp and pier; no swimming, electric motors only on the lake; alcohol prohibited. RV Life mislabeled this 'Karick Lake Upper'/'North Karick Lake'.
summary: Confirmed on the FFS ReserveAmerica page and FDACS: 15 back-in RV/tent sites, 30-60 ft, all with 30/50-amp electric and water; showers, dump station, drinking water; open year-round; ReserveAmerica same-day to 11 months.
